mode: paused edit, Qt-thread time and process CPU per edit
gate_note: the gate is on the Qt-thread time of putting the picture up (Window._show_image, the Viewer's paint, the dock's draw and overlay paint), not the whole edit: the rest of an edit (command, graph and panel refresh, status, timeline marks) is the same on every path and is reported as the whole-edit figures. The wgpu surface present call is left out of every figure but the with-present one: Xvfb has no DRI3, so presenting a Vulkan image to it copies the picture out through the processor
